seo.blurb: AI instructions, embedded in any language
seo.title: PSL — Prompt Script Language, an AI-native scripting language
seo.description: PSL (Prompt Script Language) embeds AI instructions inside files written in other languages. Wrap an instruction in delimiters and the psl compiler fills that slot with code, in place.
seo.keywords: prompt script language, psl, AI native language, prompt engineering, code generation, compiler
